arabic_text: بِنَفْسي اَنْتَ مِنْ عَقيدِ عِزٍّ لايُسامى
transliteration: bi-nafsi ʾanta min ʿaqidi ʿizzin la yusammá
english_text: I eagerly long for you who is worthy of acceptance and lawful driving force of belief and conviction, never weary or annoyed.

arabic_text: بِنَفْسي اَنْتَ مِنْ اَثيلِ مَجْدٍ لا يُجارى
transliteration: bi-nafsi anta min athīli majdin lā yujārī
english_text: I eagerly long for you who is the root of praise and distinction, never can be uprooted.

arabic_text: بِنَفْسي اَنْتَ مِنْ تِلادِ نِعَمٍ لا تُضاهى
transliteration: binafsi anta min tiladi niʿamin la tudhahiya
english_text: I eagerly long for you who is always tender, gentle and comforting, never makes one’s affairs worse instead of better.

arabic_text: بِنَفْسي اَنْتَ مِنْ نَصيفِ شَرَفٍ لا يُساوى
transliteration: bi-nafsi anta min naseefi sharafin la yusawwi
english_text: I eagerly long for you who is just and equitable beyond a trace of doubt, does not take severe action until misbehaviour trespasses the limit.

arabic_text: اِلى مَتى اَحارُ فيكَ يا مَوْلايَ وَ اِلى مَتي ، وَ اَىَّ خِطابٍ اَصِفُ فيكَ وَ اَيَّ نَجْوى
transliteration: 'ilā matā aḥāru fīka yā mawlāya wa 'ilā matī, wa 'ayyu khitābin aṣifu fīka wa 'ayya najwā'
english_text: O Master! How long and unto what is to be directed (my) request for friendly attention concerning you? And what is the message?

arabic_text: عَزيزٌ عَلَيَّ اَنْ اُجابَ دُونَكَ وَ اُناغى
transliteration: ʿazīzun ʿalayya an ujāba dūnaka wa unāghā
english_text: It makes me sad to get favourable reply from anyone other than you, but to be duped and cheated in the end.

arabic_text: عَزيزٌ عَلَيَّ اَنْ اَبْكِيَكَ وَ يَخْذُلَكَ الْوَرى
transliteration: ʿazīzun ʿalayya an abkiyaka wa yakhḏhulaka al-warā
english_text: It casts a gloom upon me that you suffered hardships and the chicken hearted deserters left you alone.

arabic_text: عَزيزٌ عَلَيَّ اَنْ يَجْرِيَ عَلَيْكَ دُونَهُمْ ما جَرى
transliteration: ʿazīzun ʿalayya an yajriya ʿalayka dūnahum mā jarā
english_text: It is painful for me what took place for you from them and that which had happened.

arabic_text: هَلْ مِنْ مُعينٍ فَاُطيلَ مَعَهُ الْعَويلَ وَ الْبُكاءَ
transliteration: hal min muʿayyinin fa-uṭīla maʿahu al-ʿawīla wa al-bukāʾ?
english_text: Is there a helper with whom I may cooperate and take pains?

arabic_text: هَلْ مِنْ جَزُوعٍ فَاُساعِدَ جَزَعَهُ اِذا خَلا
transliteration: hal min jazūʿin fausāʿid jazaʿahu idhā khala
english_text: Is there a restless with whom I may share when action is taken?

arabic_text: هَلْ قَذِيَتْ عَيْنٌ فَساعَدَتْها عَيْني عَلَى الْقَذى
transliteration: hal qadhīyat ʿaynun fasāʿadathā ʿaynī ʿalā al-qadhā
english_text: Is there a faint twinkle of evidence to make me willingly take up the trouble?

arabic_text: هَلْ اِلَيْكَ يَا بْنَ اَحْمَدَ سَبيلٌ فَتُلْقى
transliteration: hal ilayka ya bn ahmad sabīlun fatuslyā
english_text: Do you O Son of Ahmed have means and ways to arrange our meeting?

arabic_text: هَلْ يَتَّصِلُ يَوْمُنا مِنْكَ بِعِدَةٍ فَنَحْظى
transliteration: hal yattasilu yawmuna minka bi'idatin fanahza
english_text: Can you once cleverly guide the course of time, so that we may obtain our wish?

arabic_text: مَتى نَرِدُ مَناهِلَكَ الرَّوِيَّةَ فَنَرْوى
transliteration: matā nardu manāhilaka al-rawiyyah fanarwā
english_text: When shall we abridge the gap that separate us from the vision so that we may refer to the authority?

arabic_text: مَتى نَنْتَقِعُ مِنْ عَذْبِ مائِكَ فَقَدْ طالَ الصَّدى
transliteration: matā nantaqiu min ʿadhb māʾika faqad ṭālaṣ-ṣaddā
english_text: How long shall we keep waiting for your pleasing satisfying essence and quality?

arabic_text: مَتى نُغاديكَ وَ نُراوِحُكَ فَنُقِرَّ عَيْناً ( فَتَقُرُ عًُيًُوننا )
transliteration: mata nughādīka wa nurāwihuka fanuqirru ʿaynan (fataquru ʿuyūnnā)
english_text: Already the period of expectation has lasted too long! When shall we receive our share from you and have our minds set at rest?

arabic_text: مَتى تَرانا وَ نَراكَ وَ قَدْ نَشَرْتَ لِواءَ النَّصْرِ تُرى
transliteration: matā tarānā wa narāka wa qad nasharta liwā' al-nasr, turā
english_text: For we have fixed our eyes upon you and strive with perseverance. When shall we be happy, and see your beautiful form and fine aspect?

arabic_text: اَتَرانا نَحُفُّ بِكَ وَ اَنْتَ تَاُمُّ الْمَلاََ وَ
transliteration: atarana nahuffu bika wa anta ta'ummu al-mala'
english_text: Groups of cheerful willing disciplined helpers, in great numbers, gathering around you to carry out one work after the other! You fulfilling (every promise) and giving joy, heart and confidence (to the faithfuls);

arabic_text: قَدْ مَلأْتَ الاَْرْضَ عَدْلاً وَ اَذَقْتَ اَعْداءَكَ هَواناً وَ عِقاباً
transliteration: qad mala'tal arḍa 'adlan wa 'aḏaqta 'a'dā'aka hawānan wa 'iqāban
english_text: filling the earth with justice; making your enemies follow the law and accept the revolution;

arabic_text: وَ اَبَرْتَ الْعُتاةَ وَ جَحَدَةَ الْحَقِّ
transliteration: wa abarta al-ʿutata wa jaḥadat al-ḥaqqi
english_text: taking the wind out of the haughty and the boastful, and those who knew but denied the truth;

arabic_text: وَ قَطَعْتَ دابِرَ الْمُتَكَبِّرينَ ، وَ اجْتَثَثْتَ اُصُولَ الظّالِمينَ
transliteration: wa qata'ta dabira al-mutakabbirin, wa ijtasaththa usoola al-thalimeen
english_text: breaking the back of the proud and the arrogant; uprooting the roots of the unjust;

arabic_text: وَ نَحْنُ نَقُولُ الْحَمْدُ للهِ رَبِّ الْعالَمينَ
transliteration: wa naḥnu naqūlu al-ḥamdulillāhi rabbi al-'ālamīn
english_text: and we-singing the praise of Allah, the Lord of the worlds.

arabic_text: اَللّـهُمَّ اَنْتَ كَشّافُ ْالكُرَبِ وَ الْبَلْوى ، وَ اِلَيْكَ اَسْتَعْدى فَعِنْدَكَ الْعَدْوى
transliteration: allāhumma anta kaššāfu al-kurabi wal-balwā, wa ilayka astaʿdī faʿindaka al-ʿadwā
english_text: O my Allah! Thou disperses the clouds of sorrows and hardships. Unto Thee we turn to ask for help against the enemy; for Thou (alone) helps and guides.

arabic_text: وَ اَنْتَ رَبُّ الاْخِرَةِ وَ الدُّنْيا ( الاُولي ) ، فَاَغِثْ يا غِياثَ الْمُسْتَغيثينَ عُبَيْدَكَ الْمُبْتَلى
transliteration: wa anta rabbu al-akhirati wa al-dunya (al-ula), fa'ghith ya ghitha al-mustaghithin, 'ubaydaka al-mubtila
english_text: Thou (alone) puts into good order affairs of this world and shall make better the Hereafter. So come to help! O He Who is called to help the helpless, Thy servants, surrounded by calamities.

arabic_text: وَ اَرِهِ سَيِّدَهُ يا شَديدَ الْقُوى ، وَ اَزِلْ عَنْهُ بِهِ الاَْسى وَ الْجَوى وَ بَرِّدْ غَليلَهُ يا مَنْ عَلَى الْعَرْشِ اسْتَوى ، وَ مَنْ اِلَيْهِ الرُّجْعى وَ الْمُنْتَهى
transliteration: wa ʾarihi sayyidahu yā shadīd al-quwwa, wa azil ʿanhu bihi al-asá wal-jawá wa barriḍ ghaleelahu yā man ʿalā al-ʿarshi astawā, wa man ilayhi al-rujʿu wal-muntahā
english_text: Show them the face of their Leader. O the Mightiest Almighty. Allow him to put an end to evil and corruption, and satisfy his Love (for the faithfuls) and dislike (for the sinners). O He Who, from the "Arsh directs and controls all creation, and unto Him is the return, final and ultimate.

arabic_text: اَللّـهُمَّ وَ نَحْنُ عَبيدُكَ التّائِقُونَ ( الشائقون ) اِلى وَلِيِّكَ الْمُذَكِّرِ بِكَ وَ بِنَبِيِّكَ وَ اَقَمْتَهُ لَنا قِواماً وَ مَعاذاً ، وَ جَعَلْتَهُ لِلْمُؤْمِنينَ مِنّا اِماماً
transliteration: allāhumma wa naḥnu ʿabīduka al-tāʾiqūna ilā waliyyika al-muḏakkiri bik wa binabīk wa aqamthahu lana qiwaman wa ma'adhan, wa ja'althu lil-mu'mineena minna imaman
english_text: O my Allah! We are Thy servants, longing for Thy friend (appointed authority), who reminds us of Thee, and Thy Prophet, who was created as a refuge and asylum for us, established as a foundation and spring of truthfulness for us, and was made the Leader-Guide of the faithfuls.

arabic_text: فَبَلِّغْهُ مِنّا تَحِيَّةً وَ سَلاماً ، وَ زِدْنا بِذلِكَ يارَبِّ اِكْراماً
transliteration: fabbalighhu minna tahiyyatan wa salama, wa zidna bi dhalika ya rabb ikraman
english_text: Convey to him our heartfelt congratulations and welcome. Make us feel more deeply for him.

arabic_text: وَ اجْعَلْ مُسْتَقَرَّهُ لَنا مُسْتَقَرّاً وَ مُقاماً ، وَ اَتْمِمْ نِعْمَتَكَ بِتَقْديمِكَ اِيّاهُ اَمامَنا حَتّى تُورِدَنا جِنانَكَ ( جَنّاتِكَ ) وَ مُرافَقَةَ الشُّهَداءِ مِنْ خُلَصائِكَ
transliteration: wa ajʿal mustaqarruhu lana mustaqarran wa muqaman, wa atmim niʿmataka bi taqdimika iyyahu imamanā ḥattá turidánā jinānak(a) wa murāfaqat aš-šuhadāʾ min ḫuláṣāʾik(a)
english_text: O Lord! Very Kindly, make his headquarters our place of domicile and dwelling abode, and fulfill Thy promise by returning him to us as our Leader Guide, so that he takes us to the eternal land of peace and bliss, where we shall rub elbows with Thy sincere servants who shed blood to pronounce the Faith.

arabic_text: اَللّـهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلى مُحَمَّدٍ وَ آلِ مُحَمَّدٍ
transliteration: allāhumma ṣalli ʿalā muḥammadin wa āli muḥammadin
english_text: O Allah send Thy blessings on Muhammad and on the children of Muhammad.

arabic_text: وَ صَلِّ عَلى مُحَمَّدٍ جَدِّهِ وَ رَسُولِكَ السَّيِّدِ الاَكْبَرِ ، وَ عَلى اَبيهِ السَّيِّدِ الاَصْغَرِ وَ جَدَّتِهِ الصِّدّيقَةِ الْكُبْرى فاطِمَةَ بِنْتِ مُحَمَّدٍ صَلَّى اللهُ عَلَيْهِ وَ آلِهِ ، وَ عَلى مَنِ اصْطَفَيْتَ مِنْ آبائِهِ الْبَرَرَةِ وَ عَلَيْهِ اَفْضَلَ وَ اَكْمَلَ وَ اَتَمَّ وَ اَدْوَمَ وَ اَكْثَرَ وَ اَوْفَرَ ما صَلَّيْتَ عَلى اَحَدٍ مِنْ اَصْفِيائِكَ وَ خِيَرَتِكَ مِنْ خَلْقِكَ
transliteration: wa ṣalli ʿalā muḥammad jaddihi wa rasūlika al-sayyidi al-akbar, wa ʿalā abīhi al-sayyidi al-a wa jaddatihi al-siddiqati al-kubra fatimah bint muhammad salla allahu 'alayhi wa alihi, wa 'ala mani istafaytamin aba'ih al-barrati wa ʿalayhi afḍala wa akmal wa atmama wa adwama wa akthara wa awfara mā ṣallayta ʿalā aḥadin min asfiyāʾika wa khīyaratika min khalqik.
english_text: Bless his ancestor Muhammad, the Messenger, the foremost Leader, and bless his progenitor, the succeeding Leader, and his great grandmother, the ever truthful, Faatimah daughter of Muhammad, and his chosen virtuous forefathers, and send blessings on him, superior, whole, conclusive, staying, numerous, and full, not ever bestowed (even) on any of Thy sincerely attached and pious friends from among Thy creation.
